name: codeledger
description: Deterministic context selection and agent governance for AI coding agents. Scores every file across 10 signals and delivers a minimal, ranked context bundle — so your agent reads the right files first. Includes CI governance pipeline, intent drift detection, Cowork session lifecycle, and multi-language scanning.
